phase: P02 (batch 1: migration history integrity and structural index checks)
environment: Disposable postgres:15-alpine container on a loopback-only random port with synthetic credentials; several throwaway databases; container removed afterwards. No existing database touched.
scope: prisma/schema.prisma (72 models, 31 enums, 10 PostgreSQL schemas) - structural checks only in this batch

findings.problem: A database built with `prisma migrate deploy` (the production path) lacked order_status_enum values pending/confirmed/processing/shipped/delivered and the order_management.admin_notifications table. Development and CI used `prisma db push`, which hid the drift. Checkout completion writes an admin notification inside its interactive transaction; the caught P2021 still aborts the PostgreSQL transaction, so the commit fails with 25P02 and the checkout is lost. Any transition into the missing statuses is rejected by the enum.
findings.change: Migration 20261116090000_reconcile_order_status_and_admin_notifications: ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS with BEFORE/AFTER positions matching schema order; CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS so databases already patched by db push are unaffected.
findings.verification: On a migrated database before the fix: Prisma transaction reproducing the checkout pattern failed with 25P02 and 'pending' cast was rejected. After: same transaction commits; enum order created,pending,confirmed,paid,processing,shipped,delivered,fulfilled,partially_returned,refunded,cancelled; zero drift on upgrade, fresh and db-push-then-migrate databases.

findings.problem: CI built its test database with `prisma db push`, so the committed migration history was never exercised and drift could not be detected.
findings.change: CI runs `prisma migrate deploy` followed by `pnpm run check:migrations` (`prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource ... --to-schema-datamodel ... --exit-code`, cross-platform).
findings.verification: check:migrations fails (Prisma exit 2, reported by pnpm as 1) on the pre-fix database with the expected table/enum differences and passes on corrected databases.

findings.problem: Redundant indexes: fulfillment.shipments(order_id) indexed twice (idx_fulfillment_shipments_order_id and idx_shipments_order_id), and loyalty_accounts(user_id) had a plain index beside its unique-constraint index.
findings.change: Removed both from the schema and dropped them in a migration. Prisma's differ matches indexes by column list and did not report the shipments duplicate, so that DROP is hand-written.
findings.verification: Catalog query for indexes sharing table and column list (including unique/plain overlap) returns none afterwards; drift check passes.

findings.problem: 5 of 90 foreign keys had no index on their referencing columns: editorial_look_products.product_id, editorial_looks.hero_asset_id, variant_media.asset_id (all used by registered catalog lookup handlers) and user_profiles.default_address_id / default_payment_method_id. Parent deletes with cascade/set-null scan the child tables.
findings.change: Added @@index for each and the generated CREATE INDEX migration.
findings.verification: Unindexed-foreign-key catalog query returns 0 on every test database.

findings.problem: A fulfillment migration outside prisma/migrations (never run by Prisma) duplicated columns/indexes already created by the init migration; indexes-to-add.sql held 198 unexecuted 'historical' index proposals.
findings.verification: All fulfillment columns/indexes present on a database built from the real history; 196 of 198 proposals already covered by an existing index with the same leading columns; the remaining two (loyalty_accounts.program_id, points_balance) recorded for P09 query review.

checks_without_findings: All money columns are Decimal(12,2) (16 columns); no Float fields in the schema.
All 13 migrations apply in order to an empty database; migration_lock provider is postgresql.

final.databases: fresh, upgraded-from-10, db-push-then-migrate and clean 13-migration builds: deploy ok, drift exit 0, 0 unindexed foreign keys, 0 duplicate indexes
final.unit: Prisma client regenerated; 1451 unit tests in 110 files pass; root/tooling tsc and API client drift check pass

remaining_p02: Model-by-model review of constraints, nullability, cascade/set-null policies, ownership and uniqueness against repository usage (72 models).
Deprecated multiSchema preview flag; Prisma 6.19.3 -> later major is a separate upgrade decision.

Existing production databases created with db push have no _prisma_migrations baseline; adopting migrate deploy there requires `prisma migrate resolve --applied` for the historical migrations (owner/deployment decision).
